primaryTextRead.text: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z
wikipediaRead.locator: L–Z list, “Mahath” subsection, lines 272–279: distinguishes two Kohathite Levites, including one from Hezekiah’s time; the 2CH 29:12 person is a Kohathite Levite in Hezekiah’s reign.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版人物一覧は、マハトを二人に分け、その一人をヒゼキヤ時代のコハテ族レビ人として挙げています。歴代誌下29:12の人物に合う記述です。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The section distinguishes two referents and describes the Hezekiah-era Kohathite Levite, matching the fixed WEB witness at 2CH 29:12.
